verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a native iOS/iPadOS Git client that runs entirely on the user's device, so there is no hosted core service to self-host. Self-hosting is a wrong-axis question for this kind of product. Its documented support for private GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea instances, and community use with self-hosted git servers, is about connecting to self-hosted remotes, not about self-hosting Working Copy itself.
